summary: Awaiting a proven j2cs Promise resumes with its fulfillment value through the JavaScript promise-job scheduler.

target.notes: The awaiter must preserve a JS microtask boundary even when the underlying promise is already settled.

caveats: Direct Task await can synchronously continue for an already-completed awaitable and reorder observable effects.

tests.name: settled promise still resumes later
tests.input: async function f(){ console.log(await Promise.resolve(4)); } f(); console.log('sync');

tests.name: sequential awaits keep order
tests.input: async function f(){ console.log(await 1); console.log(await 2); } f(); console.log(0);
tests.expected_behavior: prints 0,1,2 with a suspension boundary at each await
